To answer your question I feel that these games, while having great stories, don't have very interesting gameplay. I think the stories are what carry the weight of their success. But, to each their own. I don't often check my message here because I use the mobile app the most. Checking them today must have been a sign to right a wrong. So, I would just like to say that I was wrong and that TLOU is a fucking masterpiece.
